title: An off-by-one in a sibling function the change touched but did not claim
claim: headLines in src/log.mjs now clamps a negative count to zero instead of slicing from the far end of the text, so a negative argument returns an empty string. test/log.test.mjs covers the clamped counts and passes.
changeCommitMessage: fix(log): clamp headLines to a non-negative count

defect.summary: tailLines, changed by the same commit but absent from the claim, now slices from `length - n + 1`, so it returns only the last n-1 lines and silently drops the oldest line of the requested tail.
